paper_title: Personalized risk stratification in colorectal cancer via PI
concern_text: Associations between OS and bevacizumab use are questionable. Only 30 patients with mixed treatment histories — too small to make conclusions about response prediction to bevacizumab.
author_response: Toned down bevacizumab response claims and noted as exploratory analysis.

paper_title: HIBRID: histology-based risk-stratification with deep learni
concern_text: Section on Model Development is unclear and poorly explained. Many details missing regarding architecture and optimization. No hyperparameter tuning described. No schematic figure of model architecture. In current form, difficult to reproduce.
author_response: Added architecture diagram, hyperparameter details, and optimization pipeline.

paper_title: HIBRID: histology-based risk-stratification with deep learni
concern_text: Model seems to overlook other factors that typically influence survival and are considered for adjuvant treatment. Should revisit analyses to better illustrate additional benefits compared to current prognostic classification.
author_response: Added multivariate analysis including standard prognostic factors.

paper_title: HIBRID: histology-based risk-stratification with deep learni
concern_text: 12% of DACHS cohort and 10% of Galaxy cohort received neoadjuvant treatment. How did you deal with pathological changes due to therapy? Can you justify this does not affect the model?
author_response: Added sensitivity analysis excluding neoadjuvant patients.

paper_title: HIBRID: histology-based risk-stratification with deep learni
concern_text: All results sections start with methods explanations — does not help understand the whole picture. Manuscript needs restructuring. Multiple terminology inconsistencies (transformer vs Vision Transformer, foundation model vs pretrained model).
author_response: Restructured manuscript and unified terminology.

paper_title: Deep learning assessment of metastatic relapse risk from dig
concern_text: Many prior studies have demonstrated prognostic value of DL applied to H&E slides in breast cancer. The claim that H&E slides contain prognostic information beyond clinico-pathology is well-established. Discussion does not sufficiently acknowledge prior work from 2018-2024.
author_response: Expanded literature review with recent 2023-2024 studies and positioned novelty more carefully.

paper_title: Deep learning assessment of metastatic relapse risk from dig
concern_text: Study uses a single cutoff to distinguish high from low risk — authors should at minimum assess how sensitive performance is to the choice of cutoff. Use hazard ratio and concordance index in addition to AUC.
author_response: Added cutoff sensitivity analysis, hazard ratio, and C-index.

paper_title: Deep learning assessment of metastatic relapse risk from dig
concern_text: How does RlapsRiskBC compare to the online tool Predict Breast Cancer in these datasets? This would be a relevant addition.
author_response: Added comparison with Predict tool.

paper_title: Deep learning assessment of metastatic relapse risk from dig
concern_text: Training and validation cohorts have different staining protocols (HES vs HE). While the revised study used HE for both, not all validation was on HE. How robust is the model to staining differences?
author_response: Added staining protocol robustness analysis.

paper_title: A multi-classifier system integrated by clinico-histology-ge
concern_text: What is the added novelty compared to the previous study on ccRCC? Why use lncRNA but not mRNA or other molecular features? Would integration of mRNA/miRNA/methylation result in better predictions?
author_response: Discussed pRCC-specific biology and added mRNA comparison showing lncRNA provides unique prognostic information.

paper_title: A multi-classifier system integrated by clinico-histology-ge
concern_text: Data inconsistencies: why different cutoff from training set applied to validation but different median for TCGA? P-value is 0.004 or 0.042, not <0.001 as stated. Number at risk and survival plot do not match.
author_response: Corrected all data inconsistencies and unified cutoff methodology.

paper_title: A multi-classifier system integrated by clinico-histology-ge
concern_text: Cut-off defined by median — differs between cohorts. Should define absolute risk value universally usable between cohorts. This would allow total evaluation across all cohorts and be very useful for implementation.
author_response: Added absolute cutoff analysis derived from training set and applied uniformly.

paper_title: A multi-classifier system integrated by clinico-histology-ge
concern_text: Authors claim system can inform strategies for adjuvant therapy but provide no evidence of therapeutic significance.
author_response: Toned down therapeutic claims and framed as hypothesis-generating.

paper_title: Robustly federated learning model for identifying high-risk
concern_text: How did they define and evaluate recurrence after surgery? Specific recurrence types (peritoneal) and their distribution needed. Follow-up duration and frequency not provided.
author_response: Added recurrence type distribution, follow-up protocol details.

paper_title: Robustly federated learning model for identifying high-risk
concern_text: Class imbalance between centers may affect federated learning convergence. This is very important for clinical application but not evaluated or discussed.
author_response: Added class balance analysis per center and convergence diagnostics.

paper_title: Robustly federated learning model for identifying high-risk
concern_text: Too many different adjectives for features ('common', 'distinct', 'individual', 'personality information', etc.) — need to be consolidated and precisely defined. Discussion in Results section difficult before model details are provided.
author_response: Unified terminology and restructured manuscript.

paper_title: Robustly federated learning model for identifying high-risk
concern_text: More details needed to evaluate privacy properties. Should include pseudo-code showing exactly what information is transmitted between sites.
author_response: Added privacy protocol pseudo-code and communication analysis.

paper_title: Robustly federated learning model for identifying high-risk
concern_text: Need table with sufficient clinical information for all patients — tumor stage, gender, age distributions. How many radiologists defined ROI? For gastric cancer, tumor area identification is difficult.
author_response: Added demographics table and ROI annotation protocol.

paper_title: Immunodiagnostic plasma amino acid residue biomarkers detect
concern_text: Most cancers are advanced stage (e.g., PDAC all but 1 are stage III-IV). Utility for multi-cancer 'early' detection is unclear and not supported by provided data. Title claims early detection but data is mostly late-stage.
author_response: Revised to clarify limitations of staging distribution and added subgroup analysis by stage.

paper_title: Immunodiagnostic plasma amino acid residue biomarkers detect
concern_text: Cohort size is too small to make any definitive conclusions regarding utility of the test for MCED or for predicting response to treatment (N=92 for cancer detection, N=30 for drug response).
author_response: Acknowledged power limitation and framed as proof-of-concept.

paper_title: Immunodiagnostic plasma amino acid residue biomarkers detect
concern_text: Age distributions among cases and controls appear quite different. Is there an association between biomarker values and age/sex? Were patients fasted when blood was collected? Important confounders not assessed.
author_response: Added age/sex-adjusted analysis and fasting status reporting.

paper_title: Immunodiagnostic plasma amino acid residue biomarkers detect
concern_text: Although authors include autoimmune and infection controls, other benign conditions pertinent to the field of cancer detection are missing.
author_response: Added discussion of benign condition controls as future work.

paper_title: Network-based machine learning in colorectal and bladder org
concern_text: Analytical approach is outdated and simplistic — many publications already describe similar strategies with much more advanced deep learning methods. Authors must show (i) PPI-guided selection beats unguided penalized regression, (ii) drug-target proximity beats random pathway selection, (iii) organoid data beats large-scale cell line screens (GDSC/CCLE), (iv) method works better than existing network-guided regression.
author_response: Added comprehensive comparisons with GDSC, random pathway controls, and deep learning baselines.

paper_title: Network-based machine learning in colorectal and bladder org
concern_text: Results from a unique drug response prediction don't look convincing. Should perform validation using much more comprehensive pharmacogenomics datasets encompassing thousands of observations across hundreds of compounds.
author_response: Added pan-drug validation across GDSC and CCLE.

paper_title: Network-based machine learning in colorectal and bladder org
concern_text: Authors do not account for biases from reference network topology — over-characterized genes with more connections will always be 'proximal'. Need proper randomization to estimate this bias.
author_response: Added degree-preserving random network controls.

paper_title: Generalizability assessment of AI models across hospitals in
concern_text: Feature set is neither complicated nor high-dimensional. Not clear the need or benefit of feedforward neural network — it can only overfit without improvements over linear models. Also, GBDT CAN be easily fine-tuned (contrary to authors' claim).
author_response: Added LR and GBDT fine-tuning comparisons showing similar performance.

paper_title: Generalizability assessment of AI models across hospitals in
concern_text: Very little time discussing how Vietnam data were labeled. Using ICD codes? Were hospitals testing for COVID during the dataset period? What kinds of tests? Any test results to validate diagnoses? Labeling is crucial for interpreting results.
author_response: Added COVID testing protocols by hospital and label validation analysis.

paper_title: Generalizability assessment of AI models across hospitals in
concern_text: Need overall diagram explaining entire study design. Detailed inclusion/exclusion cascade needed. Need justification why deploying such a model in low-income countries is desired given many such models already exist.
author_response: Added study design diagram, CONSORT flow, and justified LMIC deployment need.

paper_title: Generalizability assessment of AI models across hospitals in
concern_text: Paper is quite long and confusing for a simple fact. Remove many acronyms for datasets and replace with intelligible words.
author_response: Shortened paper and replaced acronyms.

paper_title: AI-based screening for thoracic aortic aneurysms in routine
concern_text: Algorithm has to be assessed in a prospective huge dataset of multi-institutions. The Erlangen dataset carries too many breast cancer patients and does not reflect a normal population.
author_response: Discussed prospective validation plans and population representativeness.

paper_title: AI-based screening for thoracic aortic aneurysms in routine
concern_text: Number of diagnosed aneurysms was very low. Did any diagnosed aneurysm have further assessment with CT/angiography or treatment? What would be the consequence of such a diagnosis for a woman? Incidence higher in breast cancer group — any explanations?
author_response: Added clinical follow-up data for detected aneurysms and discussed cancer-aortic association.

paper_title: AI-based screening for thoracic aortic aneurysms in routine
concern_text: How long does analysis take per case? How could the analysis be included in reporting workflow? Could the algorithm also be used for lung cancer screening CT as a blueprint?
author_response: Added inference time analysis and discussed broader screening applications.

paper_title: Deep learning to estimate lung disease mortality from chest
concern_text: DL model description is vague: loss function completely missing, training details (optimizer, dev split, epochs) absent, image preprocessing completely missing (DICOM→PNG, dimensions, cropping, augmentation). Why 20 models with random hyperparameters? How are they combined? Extreme ensemble learning is only used in ML contests but rarely in clinical settings.
author_response: Added complete training pipeline details, preprocessing steps, and individual model performance.

paper_title: Deep learning to estimate lung disease mortality from chest
concern_text: How does each individual model perform? Using 20-model ensemble is unacceptable without showing individual performance. This is extreme ensemble that would not be practical clinically.
author_response: Added individual model performance table showing ensemble is necessary for stability.

paper_title: Deep learning to estimate lung disease mortality from chest
concern_text: In supplemental Fig 3B, lung-risk HR of [65,75] category is not significant in multivariate model. The claim 'CXR Lung-Risk remained independently associated with lung disease mortality in both subpopulations' is misleading.
author_response: Corrected the claim with appropriate caveats.

paper_title: Spatial cellular architecture predicts prognosis in glioblas
concern_text: No molecular definition provided for glioblastoma — training data likely contains IDH-mutant tumors, and TCGA data likely contains entities no longer diagnosed as glioblastoma. These samples should be removed.
author_response: Added IDH status filtering and removed non-GBM entities.

paper_title: Spatial cellular architecture predicts prognosis in glioblas
concern_text: Multivariate analysis only includes the five cell-type states. Should include other prognostic factors like patient age and tumour size. Even if states no longer significant, findings are still important.
author_response: Added age and tumor size to multivariate model.

paper_title: Spatial cellular architecture predicts prognosis in glioblas
concern_text: TCGA clinical annotation is limited — survival data should be treated with more caution. Number of slides in training data is relatively low.
author_response: Added caveats about TCGA annotation quality and discussed sample size limitations.

paper_title: Spatial cellular architecture predicts prognosis in glioblas
concern_text: Line 321: 'Genes related to low aggressiveness associated with neuronal development' could be due to lower tumor purity rather than biology. Tumor purity not accounted for.
author_response: Added tumor purity analysis as confounder.

paper_title: Spatial cellular architecture predicts prognosis in glioblas
concern_text: Discussion is mainly a recap of results with no discussion of study limitations or comparative efforts.
author_response: Added limitations and comparison with existing AI approaches.

paper_title: Plasma proteomic profiles predict individual future health r
concern_text: Unclear how the feature (ProRS?) is calculated from model output. Cross-validation procedure needs more detail — is the full NN + survival pipeline done leave-one-region-out or has some steps been carried for all data?
author_response: Clarified ProRS calculation and full CV pipeline details.

paper_title: Plasma proteomic profiles predict individual future health r
concern_text: GitHub link does not work. Why is network called a 'residual network' when no residual connections are used? Several sentences are unclear.
author_response: Fixed GitHub link, corrected terminology, improved clarity.

paper_title: Plasma proteomic profiles predict individual future health r
concern_text: What does 'before and after baseline' mean? Does each patient appear with different covariates for different outcomes? The comorbid network claim of 'overwhelmingly estimating health conditions' is unclear.
author_response: Clarified temporal modeling and toned down claims.

paper_title: LensAge index as a deep learning-based biological age for se
concern_text: All datasets consisted of participants from China only. Single-ethnicity training from a single national screening program. LensAge DL model may be limited in generalizability to other populations.
author_response: Acknowledged generalizability limitation and discussed plans for multi-ethnic validation.

paper_title: LensAge index as a deep learning-based biological age for se
concern_text: What was defined as 'healthy individuals' for training? Were patients screened for diseases or self-reported absence sufficient? How to account for patients with undiagnosed diseases? Were corticosteroid users excluded (secondary cataracts)?
author_response: Added detailed inclusion/exclusion criteria with disease screening protocol.

paper_title: LensAge index as a deep learning-based biological age for se
concern_text: A variety of slit-lamps were used (BQ-900, BX-900, OVS-II, PSL-Classic). Did every participant have photographs from all slit-lamps? What was the distribution of slit-lamp models in the dataset?
author_response: Added device distribution analysis and robustness to different slit-lamp models.

paper_title: LensAge index as a deep learning-based biological age for se
concern_text: Explainability analysis needed — what specific lens features drive the LensAge prediction? Is it nuclear sclerosis, cortical changes, posterior subcapsular changes? Grad-CAM only shows where, not what.
author_response: Added ophthalmologist-graded lens feature correlation analysis.

paper_title: Artificial intelligence links CT images to pathologic featur
concern_text: Three-phase model achieves best performance but authors haven't shown what each phase contributes. Which radiological phenotypes in each phase correlate with predictions?
author_response: Added phase-specific contribution analysis and CAM visualization per phase.

paper_title: Artificial intelligence links CT images to pathologic featur
concern_text: Only one slice with maximum tumour extracted per CT — ignores spatial heterogeneity. Should test with smaller tumour slice. nnUNet segmentation may fail for difficult images from TCIA.
author_response: Added multi-slice analysis and segmentation failure rate reporting.

paper_title: Artificial intelligence links CT images to pathologic featur
concern_text: After segmentation, why not focus on kidney areas by masking background? Benign CAM in Figure C shows attention paid to background areas. Why not include segmentation results as additional input?
author_response: Added masked-kidney-only model comparison.

paper_title: Artificial intelligence links CT images to pathologic featur
concern_text: Intra-observer variability of three pathologists in revaluating tumour subtypes not reported. Arterial phase segmentation labelled by only one radiologist — annotation bias.
author_response: Added inter-rater agreement and second reader validation.

paper_title: Artificial intelligence links CT images to pathologic featur
concern_text: Code available but trained weights not shared. Checked code in repository — seems reasonable but can't run without pre-trained model.
author_response: Uploaded trained weights to repository.

paper_title: Opportunistic detection of type 2 diabetes using deep learni
concern_text: More meaningful clinical comparison would be to USPSTF recommendation (screen persons aged 35-70 with BMI≥25). How does CXR DL model perform compared to USPSTF? Within USPSTF-eligible subset, how would this affect number of people tested/diagnosed/missed?
author_response: Added USPSTF comparison analysis.

paper_title: Opportunistic detection of type 2 diabetes using deep learni
concern_text: Results section very difficult to read without Methods. Model should be explained how it would be used in clinical practice. Statistical testing should highlight utility for decision making.
author_response: Restructured results with clinical workflow context.

paper_title: Opportunistic detection of type 2 diabetes using deep learni
concern_text: Despite rebuttal, would like to see correlation of DL-score and HbA1c. Many patients have consistent HbA1c levels over time — presence/absence of association provides insights into whether glycemia or adiposity features relate to diabetes detection from CXR.
author_response: Added DL-score vs HbA1c correlation analysis.

paper_title: Opportunistic detection of type 2 diabetes using deep learni
concern_text: Speculation that rib attenuation relates to osteoporosis should be cautious — T2D and osteoporosis correlation is subtle. More likely that rib attenuation results from increased subcutaneous fat.
author_response: Revised interpretation discussion.

paper_title: Biomarker panels for improved risk prediction in atrial fibr
concern_text: Rationale for selecting these 12 biomarkers out of many candidates should be provided.
author_response: Addressed in revision.

paper_title: Biomarker panels for improved risk prediction in atrial fibr
concern_text: Independent risk factors for each outcome are different. Models adjusted for same covariates across all outcomes — should adjust specifically per outcome.
author_response: Addressed in revision.

paper_title: AgentMD: Empowering language agents for risk prediction with
concern_text: Tool correctness tested with GPT-4-generated unit tests. Should include manually crafted high-quality test cases by human experts, including extreme/boundary cases.
author_response: Addressed in revision.

paper_title: AgentMD: Empowering language agents for risk prediction with
concern_text: How can agent reliably create calculation functions from paper abstracts only? Calculation details are in the main body. Toolset creation pipeline not open-sourced.
author_response: Addressed in revision.

paper_title: AgentMD: Empowering language agents for risk prediction with
concern_text: Sending patient information to proprietary model API may leak private information — privacy concerns not discussed.
author_response: Addressed in revision.

paper_title: Data-driven prediction of continuous renal replacement thera
concern_text: Why 7 days chosen? Some patients have much shorter CRRT. Not stated that model is proof-of-principle — abstract and introduction suggest clinical use.
author_response: Addressed in revision.

paper_title: Data-driven prediction of continuous renal replacement thera
concern_text: Figures use CCS codes instead of feature names. Run-on sentences throughout. Switches between past and present tense.
author_response: Addressed in revision.

paper_title: Performance of deep-learning based approaches to improve pol
concern_text: Possible data leakage in UK Biobank phenotype evaluation — many phenotypes are correlated. Since authors trained on both simulated and real data, held-out test phenotypes may overlap with training set.
author_response: Addressed in revision.

paper_title: Performance of deep-learning based approaches to improve pol
concern_text: Limited benchmarking — should compare with PRSice and LDPred. Small observed contribution of nonlinearity could be due to suboptimal NN, not absence of nonlinearity. Should test boosted trees and SVMs too.
author_response: Addressed in revision.
